name: Strictly Business

tenures.source: the fed's own served Royal Rampage V recap page (promotions/rcw-royal/archive/royal-rampage-v.html)

caption: Challenged RCW World Tag Team Champions The Commission at Royal Rampage V, a match ended by disqualification when Dominion and Minions of Darkness ran in.
notes: Warren Knight and Jesse Bishop's own billed ring-team name for this match; both are also named, alongside Jonathan Steel, as members of the larger stable The Firm within the same recap.

identity.note: An exact-name collision against CSWA own Strictly Business (John Cisco and Mark Davis, managed by Terra Lopez), surfaced by the standing mint guard. No document on either side names the other fed or claims a shared team; Strictly Business is a generic tag-team name independently reused across the held record. Filed distinct pending evidence, per the collision doctrine -- when in doubt we do not merge.

name: SyndiCorp

tenures.source: the fed's own served Royal Rampage V recap page (promotions/rcw-royal/archive/royal-rampage-v.html)

caption: Jake Rockwell and RCW World Champion The Executive's own alliance, dissolved by Rockwell on-air after the Royal Rampage V main event, moments before he attacked both Executive and Jack McGriff with a crowbar.
notes: The recap's own text names the group both "The Syndicate" and "The SyndiCorp" within the same post-match segment; Rockwell's own membership is explicit (he "resolves" it himself), The Executive's is implied by Rockwell blaming him for "dragging...
